user.title: Where are your photos?
user.description: PosterWall pins your photos like a pinboard on any screen. Choose where the photos come from – you can change everything else later in the **PosterWall** panel.

menu_options.media: Home Assistant media (folder, NAS share, any media source)

folder.title: Pick the folder
folder.description:
You are in **{path}** – {photos} photos here, {folders} folders.

Open a folder or take this one with ✓. Sub folders are included automatically, and you can switch between them later.

immich.title: Immich
immich.description: Address of your Immich server and an API key (Immich → Account settings → API keys; the permissions *asset.read*, *asset.view*, *album.read* and *user.read* are enough).

synology.title: Synology Photos
synology.description: Address of the DiskStation and a user that may use Synology Photos. Tip: create a separate user with read access only.

otp.title: Two-factor code
otp.description: Type the current code of your authenticator app. The DiskStation then trusts PosterWall and does not ask again.

display.title: Almost done
display.description: Photos from **{source}** are ready. Name the wall and choose what is shown next to the photos – everything can be changed later.

data_description.name: For example Kitchen or Living room

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: {url} does not accept the stored sign-in anymore. Enter it again.

reconfigure.title: Where are the photos now?
reconfigure.description: Keep the same kind of source or switch to another one. Settings, entities and screens of the wall stay.

menu_options.media: Home Assistant media (folder, NAS share, any media source)

error.cannot_connect: The server cannot be reached. Check the address.
error.invalid_auth: Sign-in refused. Check user, password or API key.
error.invalid_otp: The code was wrong or too old. Try the next one.

init.title: Weather and calendars
init.description: Everything else – interval, effects, night mode, screens – is in the **PosterWall** panel in the sidebar.

show.name: Show on a screen
show.description: Shows a wall on a Google Cast screen, a Fully Kiosk tablet or a Browser Mod browser.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: Screen id as listed in the PosterWall panel, for example cast:media_player.kitchen_display.

keep.name: Keep showing
keep.description: Start the wall again when the screen has nothing else to do.

echo_not_ready.message: The Echo does not list the page “{page}” yet. It reads its list of dashboards every few minutes – try again in 5 minutes.

screens_hung.title: PosterWall {wall}: a screen shows no photos
screens_hung.description: {screens} has shown no new photos for a while and restarting did not help, so PosterWall stops restarting it. Most common cause with Echos: the TECHO5 dashboard server is not running. This notice goes away by itself as soon as the screen shows photos again.
